description: This file contains database migration logic for the OrchardCore.Users module, defining schema creation, updates, and data transformations related to user indexes and properties.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema migrations for the OrchardCore.Users module, including creation and updates of user-related indexes and data transformations.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Initial migration creating user index tables and indexes, returning the latest schema version (13).

methods.name: UpdateFrom1Async
methods.description: Migration step to create UserByLoginInfoIndex table.

methods.name: UpdateFrom2Async
methods.description: Migration step to create UserByClaimIndex table.

methods.name: UpdateFrom3Async
methods.description: Migration step to add 'IsEnabled' column to UserIndex.

methods.name: UpdateFrom4Async
methods.description: Migration step to add 'UserId' column to UserIndex.

methods.name: UpdateFrom5
methods.description: Deferred task to initialize UserId to UserName for existing users.

methods.name: UpdateFrom7
methods.description: Deferred task to replace '@' with '+' in usernames.

methods.name: UpdateFrom8Async
methods.description: Recreates indexes on UserIndex, UserByLoginInfoIndex, UserByClaimIndex.

methods.name: UpdateFrom11Async
methods.description: Creates index on UserIndex for lockout info.

methods.name: UpdateFrom12
methods.description: Deferred task to update specific content in the database, related to user settings.
